title: skills: objectstack-platform says the package customizations read lists overrides, extensions and switched-off items, but not the arrangements PR #36818 adds
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzhpykmQZe1yMupC2CU

Carries the `skills/**` half of #36626's `Skills-docs:` debt; #36626 / PR #36818 keeps the schema, the producer and the `content/docs` copy. Filed by the seat on L1 finding S1 (PR #36818 comment 7120715954). Not claimed.

## What happens

PR #36818 adds a required `arrangements` list (`{ object, key }`, `key` from `CUSTOM_ARRANGEMENT_KEYS`: `fieldGroups`, `relatedLists`, `actionLayout`) and `counts.arrangements` to the answer of `GET /api/v1/packages/<base>/customizations` (`Metadata-protocol: added`). It corrects the docs copy of the sentence that teaches this read (`content/docs/api/metadata-api.mdx`), but the skill copy stays as it was:

- `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md:129` (origin/main 844218f5): "`GET /packages/hotcrm/customizations` lists its overrides, extensions and switched-off items" — and line 131 adds `contributions`. After #36818 merges, a tab, field-group or action-layout arrangement made in the pair shows up in a list this skill never names, so an agent reading the skill to answer "what did we change on HotCRM" misses it.

Re-check: `git grep -n "customizations\` lists" -- skills/` (expect the one hit above until fixed).

## To do

1. Name the `arrangements` list in that sentence (one entry per object and arrangement key the pair's object extension writes; no content, no diff against the base), with the smallest wording change.
2. Keep the skill's line budget: replace words, do not add a paragraph.

## Order

After PR #36818 merges (until then the skill sentence is still true of `main`).

Blocked-by: #36818

## Grade

Suggested-grade: p2 · a published skill teaches an incomplete answer shape for a read whose new list is the only place an arrangement customization appears. area:ux · Documentation. `skills/**` is a governed surface (Tier H); the domain is triage's to set.
